clauses.quote: All employees are strictly prohibited from possession, using, transferring, selling, distributing, and being under the influence of alcohol while on the job or on school premises or off-campus in connection w;i.thor affecting any school-related activity.

Off-duty use of controlled substances, alcohol, or any other prohibited substance that results in impaired work performance or harm to the School Board's image or relationship with the general public, federal or state government is strictly prohibited.
clauses.subject_text: Off-duty use of controlled substances, alcohol, or any other prohibited substance that results in impaired work performance or harm to the School Board's image or relationship with the general public, federal or state government

clauses.quote: Each employee is required to inform the Superintendent of a designated individual within five (5) days of any conviction for a violation of any federal or state criminal controlled substance or alcohol law (including but not limdted to a conviction for driving under the influence), where such violation occurred either on or off the property of the School Board.
however, the School Board prohibits the misuse of prescribed or over-the-counter medications.

Any employee using prescription or over-the-counter medications that may pose a direct threat to the health or safety of other individuals, or the employee, (e.g., such as causing drowsiness) should report the use of such medication to his/her supervisor and NRO.
The employee is not, however, required to disclose the specific medication that he/she is taking or the condition for which the medication is being taken.
All applicants for employment in a safety-sensitive position shall be required to submit to a substance abuse test prior to employment.
The pre-employment screening shall test for the presence of controlled substances as well as alcohol,
but shall not be required until after a conditional offer is made to the applicant.
